items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: when Manuel Moneta played piano, and the shots on that date too

ctx.x: I wanted to ask some more about the records you made, those first records you told about, when Manuel Moneta played piano, and the shots on that date too. Two coronet, shots on the cellar stage. Used two coronets.
Shots led, what's he call the name there, well. It was Careless Love.
